answer: A Dedicated device bound by one-time code delivery with a ninety-day rotation cooldown ties the identity to something the applicant actually controls: the dedicated device answers a fresh challenge, the one-time code delivery is recorded, and a ninety-day rotation cooldown keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so a Sybil farm would need a separate real channel for every fake account. A lone plume cannot fake a channel; only the bound record counts. From the beacon to the yarrow, the same rule holds: no channel, no trust, no exception.
